Browser editor third-party license texts
========================================

Collected 20 October 2026 from the installed packages matching package-lock.json.
All 43 runtime package manifests declare MIT. Each distinct original license text
is reproduced below with its exact package/version list and source-file SHA-256.
Development-only packages are outside this runtime inventory. Upstream authors
retain copyright; the application's GPL does not replace these notices.

Source projects:
  Tiptap: https://github.com/ueberdosis/tiptap
  ProseMirror / orderedmap / rope-sequence / w3c-keyname: https://github.com/ProseMirror
  linkifyjs: https://github.com/nfrasser/linkifyjs
  pagination: https://github.com/RomikMakavana/tiptap-pagination-plus

To refresh: install the locked packages, inventory every packages entry without
dev=true, check installed version/license metadata, then copy each package's
LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE files verbatim. Group identical texts only while
retaining every package name/version and each copyright notice. Recheck newly
added dependencies before a release.
